messages:
olivia: Quick thread — prototype feedback for the rollout timeline compact view. Two things flagged in crit: (1) snapline focus state is hard to spot when low-contrast themes are used; (2) 'Preview rollback' label still triggers panic for some PMs. Link: https://www.figma.com/file/zzzz/compact-rollout (internal).
ben: Re: focus: recommend a 3px glow that contrasts with theme and adds a 6px hit area for keyboard. Keep visual cue subtle but ensure focus-visible meets 3:1 against the background. Also add an audible announce: 'Snapshot 12 of 48, Mar 24, 09:12, commit abc123'.
noah: On wording: change 'Preview rollback' to 'Review changes (no traffic impact)' — clarifies it's a preview. For the destructive button use 'Rollback and Route Traffic' with a secondary 'Cancel'.
tess: Compact timeline: when rows are dense the snapshot dots overlap. Proposal: collapse low-importance snapshots into a grouped cluster marker with a count, expand on hover/focus. Ensure clusters are keyboard reachable and show a list on expand.
a11y-bot: Accessibility checklist: grouped clusters must be accessible as a composite button with aria-expanded and aria-controls. When expanding, set focus to the first item in the list. For live updates: use aria-live="polite" and include both short and full timestamp in the announcement.
ben: Motion note: the snapline pulse is nice but can be disorienting. Honor prefers-reduced-motion and add a per-user setting in timeline prefs. Also add 'pause auto-advance' control visible in compact toolbar.
oilvia: (typo) — corrected: olivia. Also, can we show a tiny commit badge on hover with author initials instead of full sha? Keeps clutter low but helps trace.
noah: Good idea. Hover shows 'by JS (J. Singh) — "fix routing"' and a small copyable short SHA. Keyboard users can press 'i' when focused to copy the SHA. Document that in keyboard help.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: snapshot-created release=v1.13.1 ts=1954321055 user=ci-pipeline
tess: Action items: Ben to spec focus glow + reduced-motion toggle, Noah to rewrite copy across preview/rollback flows, A11y-bot to produce aria snippets for clusters and live region messages, Olivia to add commit-badge microcopy. We'll test with 3 users in next research slot. Thanks!
